title: Hold My Liquor
original_lyrics:
[verse]
, #
i can hold my liquor, but this man can't handle me
dark and lonely round on chicagos south of town
i'm onto indiana, i heard it in the radio now
, #
i can't handle no liqua... but these bitches can't handle me
i can't control me niggas, and my niggas they can't control me
you say you know me my nigga, but you really just know the old me
repeat through the whole song
to do the cool screechy thing on kanye's verse play this on the high string:
or better yet bend it (start bent and pull back down to none bent)
guitar solo at 2:37 (you might be able to do this with one guitar, you just have to
throw some crazy effects on there):
-------3----6----|--11s----1------6-------------------------------
--------6--4--------6--4-x bunch--------------||
3:47 guitar Solo: (just the general notes that are played, figure out the phrasing
yourself, it's groovy pursuit)
--15----15b--15----15------11s----1-----------------------------
--8----10b----8----10--10b----------------||
end on minor
